title: ESP32 Project Configuration
description: Central configuration for project metadata and board definitions. Edit project.json to add/remove boards or rename the project.

name.description: Short project identifier used in firmware build flags, manifests, and release titles

description.description: Human-readable project description shown in web installer and README

installer.description: Web installer UI configuration. All fields drive docs/index.html via the generated window.PROJECT_CONFIG.

h1.description:
Main heading text. May contain a literal
for a line break.

subtitle.description: Subtitle paragraph shown below the h1.

description.description: One-sentence project description displayed in the web flasher header below the h1. Leave empty to hide.

youtubeUrl.description: YouTube demo video URL. When set, a '▶️ Demo' link appears in the web flasher header.

howToUrl.description: HowTo / flash guide URL. When set, a '📖 How to flash' link appears in the web flasher header. Defaults to {githubUrl}/wiki/Troubleshooting when omitted.

baseUrl.description: GitHub Pages base URL used for manifest fetching. No trailing slash.

githubUrl.description: GitHub repository URL shown in the footer.

badgeText.description: Small badge label in the page header. Defaults to 'Web Installer' if omitted.

lib_deps.description: Project-wide PlatformIO library dependencies added to all board environments. Entries use the same format as platformio.ini lib_deps (e.g. 'owner/name @ ^1.0.0' or a Git URL). Do NOT edit platformio.ini directly — add libraries here and regenerate with: python scripts/generate_platformio.py

boards.description: All supported target boards. Each entry drives the CI build matrix, platformio.ini env sections, and the web installer board list.

id.description: PlatformIO environment name. Used in firmware filenames: firmware-{id}-{version}.bin. Must be lowercase with underscores.

name.description: Human-readable board name shown in the web installer and release notes

chip.description: esptool chip name passed to esptool.py --chip

chipFamily.description: ESP Web Tools chipFamily value used in manifest.json builds[].chipFamily

bootloaderOffset.description: Bootloader flash offset passed to esptool merge_bin. Use '0x0' for C3/S3/C6 chips, '0x1000' for classic ESP32 (esp32dev).

platform.description: PlatformIO platform string or zip URL. Use 'espressif32' for standard chips, or a zip URL for unofficial forks (e.g. pioarduino for ESP32-C6).

platformioBoard.description: PlatformIO board ID (the 'board =' value in platformio.ini). Usually matches 'id' but may differ (e.g. generic_esp32 uses esp32dev).

buildFlag.description: C preprocessor #define symbol injected as -D {buildFlag} in platformio.ini build_flags. Use SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

partitionsFile.description: Custom partition table CSV filename (relative to PlatformIO project root), or null to use the platform default.

requiresUv.description: Set true if the platform requires 'pip install uv' before building. Needed for pioarduino-based platforms (e.g. ESP32-C6).

icon.description: Single emoji displayed next to the board name in the web installer UI

meta.description: Short descriptor shown below the board name in the web installer (e.g. chip · arch · flash size)

extra_lib_deps.description: Board-specific PlatformIO library dependencies added only to this board's environment(s). Same format as lib_deps entries.

sku.description: Vendor SKU or product code shown in the Hardware & Components section of the web flasher.

url.description: Product page or shop URL for this board, linked as a 'Buy →' button in the web flasher.

image.description: Product image for the Hardware & Components thumbnail. Accepts a relative path from docs/ (e.g. 'assets/boards/my-board.png') or an absolute https:// URL.

firmwareVariants.description: Firmware build variants (e.g. no-wifi vs wifi). The first entry is the default — it gets no suffix on environment names or binary filenames. Subsequent entries use '-{id}' suffixes. Drives PlatformIO env generation, CI build matrix, manifest variant field, and the web installer variant selector.

id.description: Variant identifier appended as a suffix to env names and binary filenames (e.g. 'wifi' → seeed_xiao_esp32c3-wifi). The first variant has no suffix.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the web installer variant toggle button.

description.description: Short description of what this variant provides, shown as a tooltip on the variant toggle button.

buildFlags.description: Additional PlatformIO build_flags entries injected for this variant (e.g. ['-D VARIANT_NO_WIFI']).

requiresWifi.description: Set false for variants that have WiFi provisioning compiled out. Controls whether the CI WiFi AP policy check runs for this variant's environments.

components.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) — additional hardware components used in the project. Shown in the Hardware & Components section of the web flasher below the boards list.

name.description: Component display name shown in the BOM card.

description.description: Short description of the component (e.g. resolution, interface, voltage).

sku.description: Vendor SKU or product code shown below the component name.

url.description: Product page or shop URL linked as a 'Buy →' button.

image.description: Product image for the 52×52 thumbnail. Accepts a relative path from docs/ (e.g. 'assets/components/my-part.png') or an absolute https:// URL.

branding.description: Optional social/support links shown in the web installer footer and README. Fork-friendly: replace these with your own links.

icon.description: Emoji icon displayed before the link label
